archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) for Financial precision

layouts.desktop_app_layout: Sidebar navigation (Collapsible, dark obsidian theme) + Top bar with Quick Stats & Bank Selector + Main Content Workspace with dense tables & cards.

accessibility.contrast: APCA high contrast compliant for financial data

components_to_use: recharts for financial metrics & interest variance
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully responsive Windows Desktop App style Banking Facility & Interest Working suite (CC & WCDL) with offline simulation state, complete calculation engine (Interest = Daily Outstanding * Rate * Days / 365), Bank Statement Excel/CSV Importer parser, Reconciliation engine, Reports export (Excel/PDF simulator), and dark/light desktop window wrapper with top title bar.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='cc-interest-tab', data-testid='import-statement-btn').
Never use full transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
Use JetBrains Mono for numeric amounts, interest rates, and days.
Ensure all financial tables have crisp borders and dense spacing for enterprise clarity.
Include simulated offline SQLite/IndexedDB state with realistic pre-populated data for ICICI CC, HDFC CC, Axis WCDL, SBI WCDL.
